name: implement greedy target-sequence generation
definition: generate a fixed-count greedy continuation from a given prompt with the target model
failure_mode: a changed sampling/repetition setting yields a different sequence and mismatched counts

name: initialize required model components with adequate size
definition: initialize components (instance encoder and bag classifier) so they are present, non-None, and together exceed a minimum parameter count.
failure_mode: components present but tiny/wrong shape fail the initialization checks

name: interpret a solver's satisfiability verdict text
definition: Correctly read the solver's printed verdict to distinguish satisfiable from unsatiffiable bitvector constraint sets.
failure_mode: Wrong verdict printed or output format token missing.

name: keep the generated table within size constraints
definition: Produce a solution file that stays under the allowed file size and entry-count limits while remaining complete.
failure_mode: Overlong or oversized table fails the constraint assert.
